sources.title: Turkana County Participatory Climate Risk Vulnerability Assessment Report
sources.temporal_coverage: Participatory assessment of historical/current conditions and RCP4.5/RCP8.5 projections through 2100
sources.methodology: Participatory assessment with surveys, KIIs and FGDs across 30 wards.
sources.limitations: Perception-based; proposed actions are not evaluated.

sources.title: Turbulent waters, troubled shores: the twin threats of climate change and conflict on vulnerable communities around Lake Turkana
sources.temporal_coverage: Conflict analysis published 2026; report covers Lake Turkana Basin communities
sources.methodology: International Alert conflict analysis commissioned by WFP; publisher page summarizes climate, environmental, economic and social drivers.
sources.limitations: Only substantive publisher-page summary was inspected; full report PDF was not accessible in this session.

sources.title: Facing old and new risks in arid environments: The case of pastoral communities in Northern Kenya
sources.temporal_coverage: Structured review of longstanding and emerging risks, drawing on literature available through 2023
sources.methodology: Structured literature review spanning pastoralism, climate security, conflict, conservation and large energy projects.
sources.limitations: Synthesis of literature rather than new household fieldwork; authors note contested climate-conflict mechanisms.

sources.title: Climate governance in Kenya
sources.temporal_coverage: Self-reported programming and policy processes, including Samburu work during 2018-2022
sources.methodology: Organization's public description of its county-level climate governance and peacebuilding work.
sources.limitations: Self-reported program description without independent outcome evaluation on the inspected page.

sources.title: Local forms of resilience in pastoral areas: a scoping study in Northern Kenya - Final Report
sources.organization: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research
sources.temporal_coverage: Scoping study of local resilience in northern pastoral areas, published 2023
sources.methodology: Scoping study; publisher summary describes northern Kenya local resilience actors and program implications.
sources.limitations: Only the publisher's report description was inspected; detailed methods and findings were not available in the excerpt.

claims.locator: Printed pp. 24-25, county climate impacts and livelihoods
claims.paraphrase: Turkana participants and the county assessment identify drought, floods, intense rainfall and unpredictable seasons affecting pastoral, agropastoral, farming, fishing and water-dependent livelihoods.
claims.limitations: A county assessment combines local perceptions with secondary climate information.

claims.locator: Printed p. 24, drought, grazing and insecurity
claims.paraphrase: The assessment states that drought and heat reduce pasture and water, increase grazing competition, and heighten conflict and insecurity among pastoralists.
claims.limitations: The report identifies a locally reported relationship but does not quantify conflict incidence or isolate other drivers.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: The report says drought-related water and grazing competition heightens conflict and insecurity.

claims.locator: Printed p. 24 and p. 27, water access and drought impacts
claims.paraphrase: Women and girls in Turkana often walk long distances to dig water from dry riverbeds; drought also increases malnutrition risks for pregnant and lactating women, children and older people.

claims.locator: Printed pp. 25-27, institutional constraints and community action groups
claims.paraphrase: The report says inadequate resources and weak institutional coordination constrain county adaptation, while community action groups and government support have helped farmers protect natural resources.
claims.limitations: Reported capacities; outcomes not independently evaluated.

claims.paraphrase: International Alert describes drought, floods, scarce water, shrinking grazing land and fishing pressure as amplifying competition among pastoral, agropastoral and fishing communities in Marsabit and Turkana.
claims.limitations: Publisher summary only; underlying conflict analysis was not inspected.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: The publisher summary says climate-linked resource pressures amplify competition and insecurity in the basin.

claims.locator: Publisher summary, livelihood disruption and recommendations
claims.paraphrase: The report summary says population movement, conservation restrictions and unequal access to land and water disrupt livelihoods and intensify tension; it recommends inclusive, conflict-sensitive programming.
claims.scenario: Program recommendations; impacts have not been evaluated in the inspected excerpt.
claims.limitations: Recommendations are proposals, not measured resilience outcomes.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: The report summary explicitly links unequal resource access and population movement with livelihood disruption and rising tensions.

claims.locator: Section 3.2, climate change; section 3.3, violent conflict
claims.paraphrase: The review says northern drought reduces pasture and water; raids in Turkana, Samburu and Marsabit target livestock or resource access.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: It describes climate's indirect role in resource-related raids, while noting disputed mechanisms.

claims.locator: Section 4.2.1, Sarima and Lake Turkana Wind Power Park
claims.paraphrase: In Sarima, wind-park job allocation was contested between Turkana and Samburu; the community borehole's desalination unit later failed.
claims.limitations: Evidence reflects cited studies, not a current evaluation.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Article reports wind-park job disputes increased inter-community tensions.

claims.paraphrase: At publication, oil production had not begun; the review reports roadblocks and site attacks amid community demands for water and jobs.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Review reports protests and attacks over water and employment.

claims.locator: Climate governance page, ASAL conflict drivers and county engagement
claims.paraphrase: Saferworld describes water and pasture scarcity as key conflict drivers in arid and semi-arid counties, with longer drought cycles and erratic rain intensifying competition.
claims.limitations: Organization's public framing; no supporting dataset or independent evaluation is linked on the page.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Saferworld explicitly calls water and pasture scarcity conflict drivers and says variable rainfall increases competition.

claims.locator: Climate governance page, Samburu 2018-2022 legislative process
claims.paraphrase: The organization reports supporting a Samburu legislative process that translated community priorities into a framework for structured pasture and rangeland access, alongside a peace and cohesion forum.
claims.limitations: Self-reported process and institutional outputs; the page does not evaluate conflict or resilience outcomes.

claims.locator: Publisher summary, study purpose and local resilience actors
claims.paraphrase: The scoping study's summary says pastoral resilience programs should recognize local network actors, including herders, herd owners, animal-health providers, mobile-money services and brokers.
claims.scenario: Program-design implication in publisher summary, not an evaluated intervention result.
claims.limitations: Only publisher summary inspected; recommendation is not evidence of measured resilience outcomes.

search_audit.query: Kenya climate vulnerability northern arid counties pastoralists Turkana Marsabit county report 2024 2025 primary
search_audit.outcome: Found a full county participatory risk assessment and 2026 Lake Turkana conflict analysis publisher summary; accessed the original Turkana report.

search_audit.query: Kenya climate drought conflict mediators grazing water resource conflict county UNDP climate security report
search_audit.outcome: Found county source-stated links and a literature review describing raids, resource competition and contested mechanisms; no uniform causal mechanism assumed.

search_audit.query: Kenya pastoral insecurity conflict effects on climate adaptation drought resilience access markets water county study
search_audit.outcome: Found literature on restricted pastoral mobility and security reorganization around conservancies and energy projects; direct access to the official IOM natural-resource-conflict report PDF returned 403, so no report claims were used.

search_audit.query: Kenya pastoral counties drought resilience peace capacity local peace agreements water pasture evaluation Marsabit Isiolo
search_audit.outcome: Found self-reported county governance work and an ACIAR northern Kenya scoping-study summary; neither publisher excerpt supplies independent impact evaluation.

gaps: The most detailed subnational hazard and gender evidence located is Turkana's 2023 county assessment; no newer comparable county assessment was added for Marsabit or Samburu.
International Alert and ACIAR full reports were not inspected, so related claims remain limited to publisher summaries.
Conflict-related constraints on adaptation are mostly synthesized from literature or program descriptions; independent current evaluation evidence remains limited.
